review_scope: Provider-backed frozen five-report run; source PDF bytes were inspected locally and are excluded from the committed package. No production fixes or reruns were made during this experiment.

report_reviews.reason: The run failed closed during public editorial semantic review; no final HTML was promoted. Source identity and retained evidence records were available for audit, but they are not a final public-output pass.
Grounding remained unresolved after bounded repair. No claim was promoted and no final HTML existed; source identity and failure evidence were retained for follow-up.
The report-level limitation requirement failed closed before final HTML. Retained findings and source identity were inspected, but no final public claim was treated as verified.

physical_page_audit.finding: Chartbeat aggregate data for more than 2,500 sites shows Google organic-search traffic down 33% globally between November 2024 and November 2025; the output preserves the period and population.
The licensing chart reports 69% of respondents receiving at least some income; the output preserves this as an expectation/realization distinction rather than a causal claim.
The content-priority chart uses base 264 and distinguishes the positive original-investigation direction from the negative service-journalism direction.
The creator concern chart uses base 263 and preserves the 70% attention versus 39% talent relationship.
The newsroom-AI chart uses base 265 and preserves the 44% promising versus 42% limited relationship.

report_reviews.reason: The only final HTML in the cohort was independently checked against the retained Reuters PDF pages. It contains no internal evidence identifiers; no unsupported material or unresolved retained factual claim was marked verified.

The exact frozen Adjust PDF hash was verified and retained artifact/evidence records were inspected. Public editorial quality still failed after bounded repair, so no HTML or final public claim was treated as accepted.

comparison_to_previous_retained_baseline.attribution: The comparison is observational: producer code, retained runtime state and provider/model variability differ. It is not a controlled causal improvement claim.

limitations: Four members terminated before final HTML; their retained findings and evidence-fidelity records are diagnostic evidence, not final public-output acceptance.

The per-report exporter projection for Reuters reports a missing terminal row because its local reports.sqlite attempt row has blank terminal fields; the authoritative cohort_result.json records the terminal awaiting_review/pass outcome and is used for the aggregate ledger.
Original PDF bytes, raw workflow databases, provider caches and raw usage ledgers are excluded; hashes, page counts and safe exporter projections are retained.
The run demonstrates actual terminal outcomes and one independently reviewed final HTML, but it does not establish ten-report or Step 3 readiness.
